events.title: Oasis's 'Definitely Maybe' Anniversary
events.blurb: Oasis released their iconic debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994.

angles.name: Debut Album Impact
angles.copy: Still sounds as fresh as it did back in '94. Which track from Oasis's 'Definitely Maybe' takes you back?

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair began on this day in 1969, featuring iconic performances over three days.

angles.name: Peace & Music
angles.copy: Three days of peace, music, and a generation-defining moment. What's your favourite Woodstock memory or performance?

events.title: Elvis Presley's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, passed away on this day in 1977.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: Remembering Elvis Presley, whose music and style continue to influence generations. What's your top Elvis track?

events.title: Tupac Shakur's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: Tupac Shakur was shot in Las Vegas on September 7, 1996, and tragically died six days later on September 13.

angles.name: Rap Legend
angles.copy: Remembering a rap legend gone too soon. Tupac Shakur's impact on music and culture is undeniable.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Still Electrifying
angles.copy: Remembering Jimi Hendrix, whose groundbreaking guitar work still electrifies generations. What's his most iconic riff?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', in the UK on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Crossing
angles.copy: That iconic zebra crossing! The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' album still sounds incredible today. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Still A Force
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still a force to be reckoned with. What's your favourite Pretenders song?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Still Bringing The Attitude
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the attitude and the tunes. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the original iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: Remember Your First iPod?
angles.copy: Twenty-five years since the original iPod dropped! Remember the click wheel and filling it with all your favourite tunes?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Celebrating 007's big screen debut. What's your favourite Bond film or theme song? Shaken, not stirred, of course.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary musician John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: A Voice That Changed The World
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. A voice that truly changed the world.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Iconic comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Still Making Us Laugh
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! Still making us laugh after all these years. What's your favourite Monty Python or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: Iconic Double Album
angles.copy: The Beatles' iconic 'White Album' dropped on this day in '68. Which track from the double LP is your absolute favourite?
